images.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: existing ecommerce product photograph, mannequin view. Image 1 is the EXACT EDIT TARGET; image 2 is the authoritative real product COLOR reference. This is a tightly constrained selective color correction, not a redesign. Change ONLY the olive yarn color of the beanie in image 1 to match the actual photographed yarn of image 2 as closely as possible. The target is currently much too dark, richly green and contrasty. Match the LIGHTER, muted, grayish olive/khaki of the real beanie reference: lift yarn midtones, reduce green saturation and deep dark contrast, preserve subtle natural fiber variation. Do not infer a dark military green from the word olive. Compare the beanie pixels in image 2 directly and use their observed color. Keep the exact knit stitches, fine ribs, silhouette, cuff dimensions, crown seams, embroidery size/position/design/text, crop, viewpoint, aspect ratio, lighting direction, ivory background and contact shadow from image 1. Keep embroidery thread ivory and exact cursive word "mahaleo". Keep the identical man's face, skin color, eyes, hair, pose and sweater completely unchanged. Selective beanie-only color correction. Output ONE edited photograph of image 1 with the same composition, not a collage, not the cardboard reference, no overlays. Faithful product color is the primary acceptance criterion.
